content_blocks.title: Work through the example
content_blocks.text: Read the small example, predict every output line, then run it locally with a compatible runtime. Run with the Lua 5.5 interpreter unless the example explicitly names a host API or another runtime. Keep the smallest reproducible case if the observed behavior differs.

content_blocks.code:
local function clamp(value, low, high)
    assert(low <= high, "invalid bounds")
    return math.max(low, math.min(value, high))
end

assert(clamp(12, 0, 10) == 10)
print("checks passed")

items.title: Mistake 1
items.text: Confusing Maintenance and Long-Term Support with a similarly named feature in another language or runtime. Fix: follow the version-matched reference and test the smallest example.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.text: Relying on an output order or environment capability that the language/host does not guarantee. Fix: document assumptions and make order/capabilities explicit.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.text: Skipping a boundary test or failing to check error-return values. Fix: test invalid and boundary inputs and inspect failure values.
